No live model/output, calendar, outbound communication, deployment or production write. SQLite state change is isolated fixture-only; current handler holds/caps/expiry unchanged. Final independent review and checkpoint are separate. Handyman owns and reports its updated two-case Hebrew consumer fixture separately. matchmaker: Retained SQLite and actual TS behavior with mock Graph and isolated filesystem. No provider inference, live calendar, invite delivery or production mutation. The stored internal hold is tracked and read by the existing expiry/reconciliation paths. A denied widened interval does not release a preexisting row. Ordinary legacy exact renewal releases then replaces and is not globally transactional. Native Manager binds the final union package. Previous combined native package exposed the extracted timezone fixture missing endIso. See timezone-repair-02.json for all three retained failing logs and the 123/123 native rerun. No production change in this repair. instructor: No tracked edits in this release recheck. Tests establish rendered model inputs, which offered intervals the real consumer authorizes, and isolated dispatch rejection/zero mock writes on read-only cases. Actual classifier meaning, contextual reply phrasing, live calendar behavior and invite delivery are unexercised. Mode all_offered still relies on the classifier interpreting a collective object; this sample does not guarantee arbitrary-language semantics. A free-form noncanonical conjunction and an enumerated collective can require clarification. Compound corrections remain read-only for the tested attempts; automatic choice of the replacement was deferred by the owner. handyman-release: Fixture-only release repair. Mocked provider classification and tool calls; real dispatcher, interval checking and in-memory SQLite. No model wording or outside delivery exercised. Owner excluded automatic resolution of conflicting numbered corrections. Such text must not deliberately reserve a known wrong option. Historical Handyman A2 records establish unchanged dispatch controls. The current native consumer suite passed 63 checks; the earlier expectation for the Hebrew noncanonical conjunction is superseded by the fixture-only release evidence, whose canonical Hebrew list acts and whose וגם phrasing remains read-only.
